event_data.context: Provide an opt-in eligible authenticated WebUI path through normal child runner, approvals, and resume. A host-issued scoped handle binds a parent-approved task directory including local edits; reject unsafe paths and file links, exclude Git metadata, credentials and build caches, enforce 256 MiB and 20,000 files. Keep nested spawning disabled. Route file and shell tools through the same child workspace. Use a fake adapter in production-wired integration coverage to prove sibling isolation at the same path and same-child file/shell coherence. Read back the diff and bounded test evidence into scoped result references. Parent chooses whether to apply the result. Test revocation, authorization, failure, and cancellation at the caller boundary.
event_data.summary: Bind a caller-approved immutable task snapshot to each canonical coder child and deliver verified patches and test evidence to the parent.
event_data.title: Give coding subagents isolated task workspaces
